arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near critical power (pod about 145-155 W) after the hard start, keep pod reserve above about 30 pct until the last 1.5 km, then spend it: push from about 1500 m to go, finish sprint from about 400 m. Ease if pod reserve falls fast mid-race; push if reserve stays high and power sits well below CP. Watch for incidents: rudder weed (speed drops with power steady, push_local falls), pod drift (pod vs boat-model power diverge), radio course changes (set_race_distance and tell). Compare same-direction legs with legs().

10.8 min: POD STEP at race_s ~595: pod 158 to 177 W in 30 s while speed through water (3.03), boat power (110), rate (66) all unchanged. Paddler 7/10 hard but holding. Most likely pod reading high (gain/offset step), less likely drag (weed) with paddler compensating. Cued clear_rudder as a test: if pod stays ~177 at same speed afterwards, treat pod as reading ~11 pct high from 595 s (true ~ pod/1.115) and do not trust pod reserve; use boat speed. Boat reserve 0 pct but no fade after 10 min at ~110 W boat: boat CP 101 likely too low.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. POD IS FAULTY from race_s ~595 (reads high and climbing: 158 to 199 W while speed through water, boat power and rate unchanged). Ignore shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local_mps and sustainable_shaft_power_w; judge effort from boat power_w, speed_water and fade_pct. True effort before the fault: pod ~160 W vs pod CP 149, pod reserve ~40 pct at 595 s, so now likely ~25-30 pct. Boat model (CP 101, reserve now 0) may be too low but fade starting (-3 pct). Target: boat power ~103-106 W, water speed ~2.95-3.0 m/s; give ground pace per leg (helping legs north ~1:55, against legs south ~1:85). Final push from 1600 m to go, finish sprint from ~400 m.

12.3 min: clear_rudder test: back-stroke not seen (paddler did not do it), speed dip 6 pct. Pod kept climbing to 199 W at unchanged speed, so it is a pod drift, not weed. Removed pod-based watches. Boat reserve 0, fade -3.1 pct: watch for blow-up.
